name: Fujian Assembly Hall
kicker: Long Fujian merchant hall on Trần Phú
summary: The long Fujian merchant hall at 46 Trần Phú: about 120 metres through three courts to the hall of Thiên Hậu. It began in 1697 as Kim Sơn Tự and was rebuilt by the Fujian community from 1757. If you enter only one assembly hall, make it this one.
fee: 20,000 VND from 10 Aug 2026, or a combination ticket
heroCaption: The hall court, with the gate and the incense burner

notice.title: Come in the morning
notice.body: Door hours are not published. Assembly halls are optional stops on the old-town ticket, so pick this one if you only enter one hall.

body: Walk in from 46 Trần Phú, on the even side near the market. The hall runs about 120 metres deep through three courts, back toward the Phan Chu Trinh–Nguyễn Huệ crossing. It began in 1697 as Kim Sơn Tự. From 1757 the Fujian congregation rebuilt it as an assembly hall for worship, for the founding merchants, and for meetings. The main hall is Thiên Hậu’s.
Come in the morning. If your ticket includes one assembly hall, this is the long one. Chùa Ông, at 24 Trần Phú, is the other landmark choice on the combination ticket.

figures.caption: The gate of the Fujian Assembly Hall
figures.alt: The tiled gate of the Fujian Assembly Hall in Hoi An, with three arched doors and a courtyard in front

gettingThere: Walk if you are already in the old town. From the Hoi An bus station, go via Huỳnh Thúc Kháng and Nguyễn Thị Minh Khai, across the bridge onto Trần Phú, or via Phan Chu Trinh or Trần Hưng Đạo to Nguyễn Huệ.

legs.heading: From the old town
legs.body: Walk along Trần Phú to number 46, even side, near the market.

legs.heading: From the Hoi An bus station
legs.body: Via Huỳnh Thúc Kháng and Nguyễn Thị Minh Khai, across the bridge onto Trần Phú, or via Phan Chu Trinh or Trần Hưng Đạo to Nguyễn Huệ.

admissionNote: No separate price for this building. From 10 Aug 2026: 20,000 VND per person per building, the same for every visitor (Da Nang Resolution 98/2026). Heritage centre notices of 26 Jan and 16 Mar 2026: 80,000 VND (streetscape, Chùa Cầu or Miếu Quan Công, and two other works) or 120,000 VND (adds a museum and three other works), usable through a stay of up to three days. A May 2026 article counts those as four and six works. Ask at the booth which ticket is on sale.
